A1.justification: Both complete 16-page PDFs describe TeFlow. Their main text, Appendices A–C, equations, ten tables and eight figures are readable and can be matched reliably despite layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original TeFlow evaluations on Argoverse 2, nuScenes and Waymo, together with ablations, hyperparameter analyses and qualitative results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablations and qualitative results in the main text and supplementary material.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the same architecture, motion-candidate construction, temporal weighting, consensus voting, aggregation and training losses. No algorithmic or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate scene flow on Argoverse 2, nuScenes and Waymo, including the same qualitative scenarios. Waymo and the appendix examples were already present in v1.

E2.justification: The comparator memberships in Tables 1, 2 and 7 are unchanged, as is the controlled SeFlow comparison in Table 3. Appendix qualitative comparisons retain SeFlow, VoteFlow and SeFlow++.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, training settings and ablation configurations are unchanged. Figure 1(b)'s revised caption clarifies the existing direction-change measurement rather than reporting a changed protocol.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same analyses of frame count, loss terms, candidate sources, backbones, voting, aggregation and hyperparameters, plus the same qualitative cases. Appendix reflow does not add or remove analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 and the plotted and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, TeFlow's mean Three-way EPE remains 3.57 cm on Argoverse 2 test, 4.64 cm on nuScenes validation and 3.48 cm on Waymo validation.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, shared rigid-motion assumption and mathematical definitions in Equations (1)–(10) are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises a theorem, proof or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: temporally consistent multi-frame supervision, real-time self-supervised scene flow and the stated accuracy and speed advantages. The claims of up to 33% improvement and 150-fold speedup are unchanged.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and qualifications are retained, including noise from distant frames and the potential suppression of valid pedestrian motion cues by strict consistency or weighting. The caption edit adds measurement clarity, not a new scientific interpretation.

D1.justification: The abstract and Section 4.3 change the stated code-and-weights location from KTH-RPL/OpenSceneFlow to Kin-Zhang/TeFlow. Figure 1(b) also explicitly describes direction change in degrees between consecutive frames. Training, hardware and preprocessing details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 45 references and research positioning are retained. Changes to reference backreferences reflect appendix pagination rather than added or removed cited works.

P1.justification: v2 clarifies Figure 1(b)'s caption, reformats affiliation markers and replaces 'Appendix for TeFlow' with the full paper title and 'Supplementary Material'. The remaining prose and section sequence are essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption and placement receive limited adjustments. Table 7 moves from PDF page 11 to page 12, appendix text and tables reflow, and printed page numbers disappear. Figure content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The method, empirical evidence, analyses and conclusions are unchanged. The clearer Figure 1(b) caption provides a small readability benefit, while the remaining edits concern formatting and the advertised repository location. The PDFs do not demonstrate improved code or weight availability, and the limited edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
